_note: Sixth use of the declared-input pattern, beside chooserLinkText, gameIdOverrides, copy-authorisation, support-pill and studioBand. Ruled by Matt 2026-08-13 in the AGX-1 reconciliation: the occupant check stops matching display titles and compares STABLE IDS - folder slugs - via this record, so a shelf title and a homepage box label are free to differ ('Rally Vector 3D' on the box, 'NEW - Rally Vector 3D - Championship Edition' on the shelf) without the gate calling honest copy a phantom. The mapping cannot be derived: the box label is authored homepage copy, the slug is the serving path, and nothing on the page binds them machine-readably. An occupant with no entry here fails the gate loudly - adding a box means adding a line here, which is the visible decision this record exists to force. This is not the return of the RULED_OCCUPANTS pin that the gate's own tenth-instance note warns about: that pin listed WHO may occupy (membership, which the shelf now decides), this record declares WHAT EACH LABEL MEANS (identity, which nothing else declares).
